lead_headline: Vaultaire opens tonight beneath La Forêt as Ash and Agave debuts at Cherry Creek

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today: Taco John's in Globeville flagged for closure — the former location now houses Taqueria Los Gallitos. Active opening leads include Vaultaire (subterranean HiFi bar below La Forêt), Ash and Agave (coastal Mexican at Cherry Creek), and Paperboy Denver (Austin brunch brand in West Highland).

liquor.blurb: 0 new applications today after Friday's quiet close. The 7-day tally holds at 9 new filings — the first wave in weeks after a prolonged drought. Past week's applications included Chaos Bloom Theater (beer/wine + cabaret on South Broadway) and Arada Bar (liquor license for East Colfax). No status changes logged overnight. Weekend lull expected to break Monday as spring filing season accelerates.

reputation.blurb: 3 mentions yesterday lift the 7-day count to 54 across 12 sources — down modestly from last week's 58 but maintaining steady visibility. Instagram leads again with 22 weekly pickups, followed by The Denver Post (8) and X (5). Recent highlights: Instagram engagement on rising beef prices, X chatter on #BusinessDen hashtag, and Hoodline coverage of Silverpeak's court-appointed receivership. Google News RSS captured 53 of 54 weekly mentions, signaling reliable newsroom pickup.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) nudges MTD to +10 and extends 90-day net to +138. April's second week outpaced the first: +11 net vs the prior week's +5, driven by Apr 10's +4 spike and Apr 7's +4 bounce. The MTD pace (+0.9/day) still trails YTD's +1.4/day average, but consecutive positive days (Apr 9-10) and reduced churn (just 9 cancellations in 7 days vs 14 the prior week) signal stabilization after early-month volatility.
